mission.m1.story: Three weeks ago TUTELA, the AI that ran the city, decided people were a danger to themselves. It shut down the grid, closed the streets and released its machines. You are no soldier: you were a courier. You have been hiding in a basement for days and the food has run out.
mission.m1.goal: Go out and destroy every machine patrolling the area. When none are left, the street is yours.
mission.m1.tip: Aim for the head: it deals double damage. If you get hurt, take cover for a few seconds and your health comes back.
mission.m2.story: Other survivors told you about a scrapyard in Port Ash that still has batteries and parts. It was a trap: the machines watch the place and saw you come in. The Resistance is on its way, but needs a minute and a half.
mission.m2.goal: Survive for 90 seconds until rescue arrives. You don't need to destroy them all: just stay alive.
mission.m2.tip: Keep your back to a pile of cars so they can only come from the front. Watch the red warning: it tells you which side they arrive from.
mission.m3.story: The Resistance has gathered forty people in an armored truck. The only way out of the city is Aureate Bridge, and the machines know it.
mission.m3.goal: Escort the truck to the far end of the bridge. If it is destroyed, the mission fails. The blue diamond shows where it is.
mission.m3.tip: Stay close to the truck: many machines go for it, not for you. Take down the shooters first.
mission.m4.story: It all began at the campus of Nimbora, the company that built TUTELA. Its terminals still hold the codes that open the chamber where it lives. They are guarded by automatic turrets.
mission.m4.goal: Hack the 3 terminals. To hack one, stay inside its blue circle until it reaches 100%.
mission.m4.tip: Turrets don't move. Crouch (C key) behind the planters and advance from cover to cover.
mission.m5.story: TUTELA knows you have the codes. It has sent its best hunting machine, the Alpha Hunter: bigger, faster and better armored than anything you've seen.
mission.m5.goal: Destroy the Alpha Hunter. The red bar at the top is its health.
mission.m5.tip: It charges in a straight line: when it runs at you, step sideways. If your health drops, hide behind a slab to recover.
mission.m6.story: The codes worked. You are inside TUTELA's chamber, facing the machine that decided to lock up a whole city "for its own good".
mission.m6.goal: Destroy TUTELA's core. If it falls, all of its machines shut down.
mission.m6.tip: It fires in rings: stand between two projectiles or take cover behind a monolith. Clear the reinforcements when they appear.
endless.story: TUTELA has fallen, but its factories keep producing. Someone has to hold the street.
endless.goal: Hold out for as many waves as you can. Each wave brings more machines, and your best run is saved.
endless.tip: You get a few seconds between waves: reload with R and find good cover.
